content: Google’s Vice President of Devices and Services, Shakil Barkat, all but confirmed in an interview with 9to5 Google that its next Pixel phone would cost more than the Pixel 10. Considering the ongoing RAM supply issues due to the explosion of AI data centers, the rumored price hike is not a complete surprise. Companies from Apple to Nintendo, Microsoft to Roku, have all raised their prices in response to the soaring cost of memory. Barkat said that Google had “shielded our consumers from supply fluctuations for as long as possible,” but that the “economics have fundamentally shifted and we’re not immune to that.” He went on to tell 9to5 that the Pixel lineup would see pricing “adjustments,” accordingly, that “will be rolled out dynamically to match supply realities.” The base model Pixel 11 is expected to cost $899, but would come with 256GB of storage, instead of 128GB. It’s also rumored that the Pixel 11 Pro could go from 16GB of RAM to 12GB. We won’t have to wait too long to find out for sure, though. Google’s scheduled to announce the next generation of Pixel devices on August 12th.
chineseTitle: 谷歌基本确认 Pixel 11 正在涨价
chineseSummary: 谷歌设备和服务副总裁 Shakil Barkat 在接受 9to5 Google 采访时几乎证实，其下一代 Pixel 手机的价格将高于 Pixel 10。考虑到 AI 数据中心爆炸式增长导致的持续 RAM 供应问题，涨价传闻并不完全令人意外。公司来自 [...]
chineseContent: 谷歌设备和服务副总裁 Shakil Barkat 在接受 9to5 Google 采访时几乎证实，其下一代 Pixel 手机的价格将高于 Pixel 10。考虑到 AI 数据中心爆炸式增长导致的持续 RAM 供应问题，涨价传闻并不完全令人意外。从苹果到任天堂，从微软到Roku，公司都提高了价格，以应对内存成本的飙升。巴卡特表示，谷歌“尽可能长时间地保护我们的消费者免受供应波动的影响”，但“经济已经发生了根本性的变化，我们也无法幸免。”他接着告诉 9to5，Pixel 系列的价格将会相应地进行“调整”，“将动态推出以适应供应实际情况”。 Pixel 11 的基本型号预计售价 899 美元，但配备 256GB 存储空间，而不是 128GB。还有传言称 Pixel 11 Pro 的 RAM 可能从 16GB 升至 12GB。不过，我们不必等待太久就能确定答案。谷歌计划于 8 月 12 日发布下一代 Pixel 设备。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
